---
title: "2 Panel Lollipop"
format: html
---

```{r}
#| label: qmd-setup
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl) # for excel files
library(scales)
library(patchwork)
library(ggtext)
```

```{r}
#| label: import-processed-data
#| message: false
source_file <- "data/processed/2024_value_and_quantity_export.csv"
processed_data <- read_csv(source_file)

processed_data
```

```{r}
#| label: global-top-30

top_30_countries <- processed_data |> 
  slice_max(order_by = export_value, n = 30) |> 
  pull(country)

rest_of_the_world <- processed_data |> 
  mutate(
    display_entity = ifelse(country %in% top_30_countries, country, "Rest of World"),
    geo_region = ifelse(country %in% top_30_countries, geo_region, "Global Tail")
  ) |> 
  group_by(display_entity, geo_region) |> 
  summarise(
    export_value = sum(export_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    export_quantity = sum(export_quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  arrange(display_entity == "Rest of World", desc(export_value))

global_top30 <- rest_of_the_world |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(export_value, export_quantity),
    names_to = "metric_type",
    values_to = "metric_value"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    metric_type = case_when(
      metric_type == "export_value" ~ "Export Value (USD Millions)",
      metric_type == "export_quantity" ~ "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)"
    )
  )

global_top30
```

```{r}
#| label: regional-data

regional_data <- processed_data |> 
  group_by(geo_region) |> 
  mutate(
    display_entity = fct_lump_n(
      f = country, 
      n = 3, 
      w = export_value, 
      other_level = "Rest of Region"
    ),
    display_entity = as.character(display_entity),
    display_entity = if_else(
      display_entity == "Rest of Region", 
      paste("Rest of", geo_region), 
      display_entity
    )
  ) |> 
  group_by(geo_region, display_entity) |> 
  summarise(
    export_value = sum(export_value, na.rm = TRUE),
    export_quantity = sum(export_quantity, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |> 
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(export_value, export_quantity),
    names_to = "metric_type",
    values_to = "metric_value"
  ) |> 
  mutate(
    metric_type = case_when(
      metric_type == "export_value" ~ "Export Value (USD Millions)",
      metric_type == "export_quantity" ~ "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)"
    )
  )

regional_data
```

```{r}
#| label: data-prep-top-30

global_top30 <- global_top30 |>
    mutate(display_entity = factor(display_entity, levels = rev(unique(display_entity)))) # Convert display_entity from char to fct, to retain the order 

data_quantity <- global_top30 |> 
  filter(metric_type == "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)")

data_value <- global_top30 |> 
  filter(metric_type == "Export Value (USD Millions)")

price_summary <- global_top30 |>
  pivot_wider(names_from = metric_type, values_from = metric_value) |>
  rename(
    quantity = `Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)`,
    value    = `Export Value (USD Millions)`
  ) |>
  mutate(usd_per_tonne = value * 1000 / quantity)

high_value <- price_summary |>
  filter(display_entity != "Rest of World") |>
  slice_max(usd_per_tonne, n = 3) |>
  pull(display_entity) |> as.character()

low_value <- price_summary |>
  filter(display_entity != "Rest of World") |>
  slice_min(usd_per_tonne, n = 3) |>
  pull(display_entity) |> as.character()

outliers <- c(high_value, low_value)

entity_levels <- levels(global_top30$display_entity)

styled_labels <- case_when(
  entity_levels %in% high_value ~ 
    paste0("<b style='color:#2166AC'>", entity_levels, "</b>"),  # blue = high $/tonne
  entity_levels %in% low_value ~ 
    paste0("<b style='color:#B2182B'>", entity_levels, "</b>"),  # red = low $/tonne
  .default = entity_levels
)
names(styled_labels) <- entity_levels


```

```{r}
#| label: top-30-plot
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12 

p_left <- ggplot(data_quantity, aes(x = metric_value, y = display_entity)) +
    geom_segment(
        aes(x = 0, xend = metric_value, y = display_entity, yend = display_entity), 
        color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = geo_region), size = 3) +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = scales::comma(metric_value, accuracy = 1)),
        hjust = 1.3, size = 2.5, color = "gray30"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 105000, y = "Argentina",
        label = "High volume,\nlow value per tonne",
        hjust = 1, size = 2.8, color = "#B2182B", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_x_reverse( 
        labels = scales::comma, 
        position = "top",
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0.15, 0))
    ) + # This makes the lollipops grow to the left
    scale_y_discrete(position = "right", labels = styled_labels) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none", # Hide legend here to avoid duplicates
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y.right = element_markdown(hjust = 0.5),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)",
        x = NULL,
        color = "Region"
    )

p_right <- ggplot(data_value, aes(x = metric_value, y = display_entity)) +
    geom_segment(
        aes(x = 0, xend = metric_value, y = display_entity, yend = display_entity), 
        color = "gray80", linewidth = 0.8
    ) +
    geom_point(aes(color = geo_region), size = 3) +
    geom_text(
        aes(label = scales::comma(metric_value, accuracy = 1)),
        hjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, color = "gray30"
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 30000, y = "Peru",
        label = "Low volume,\nhigh value per tonne",
        hjust = 0, size = 2.8, color = "#2166AC", fontface = "italic") +
    scale_x_continuous(
        labels = scales::comma, 
        position = "top",
        expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.15))
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
        axis.text.y = element_blank(),
        axis.title.y = element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
    ) +
    labs(
        title = "Export Value ($USD Millions)",
        x = NULL,
        color = "Region"
    )

final_plot <- p_left + p_right + 
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") +
    plot_annotation(
        title = "Value vs. Volume: Top 30 Global Agricultural Exporters (2024)",
        caption = "Source: World Trade Organization | Note: EU treated as single entity",
        theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
    ) &
    theme(
        legend.position = "bottom" 
    ) &
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

final_plot
```

```{r}
#| label: regional-data-prep

regional_plot_data <- regional_data |>
  mutate(entity_key = paste(geo_region, display_entity, sep = "___"))

key_levels <- regional_plot_data |>
  filter(metric_type == "Export Value (USD Millions)") |>
  mutate(is_rest = startsWith(display_entity, "Rest of")) |>
  arrange(geo_region, desc(is_rest), metric_value) |>
  pull(entity_key)

regional_plot_data <- regional_plot_data |>
  mutate(
    entity_key = factor(entity_key, levels = key_levels),
    is_rest = startsWith(as.character(display_entity), "Rest of")
  )

data_qty <- filter(regional_plot_data, metric_type == "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)")
data_val <- filter(regional_plot_data, metric_type == "Export Value (USD Millions)")

regional_plot_data 
```

```{r}
#| label: regional-plots
#| fig-width: 10
#| fig-height: 12 

strip_prefix <- function(x) sub("^.*___", "", x)

p_left <- ggplot(data_qty, aes(x = metric_value, y = entity_key)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = entity_key, color = geo_region, alpha = is_rest)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = geo_region, alpha = is_rest), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::comma(metric_value, accuracy = 1)),
      hjust = 1.3, size = 2.5, color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_x_reverse(
    labels = scales::comma, 
    position = "top",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0.25, 0))
  ) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right", labels = strip_prefix) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 1, "TRUE" = 0.4)) +
  facet_grid(geo_region ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Export Quantity (1,000 Tonnes)", x = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    strip.text = element_blank(),          
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y.right = element_text(hjust = 0.5),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

p_right <- ggplot(data_val, aes(x = metric_value, y = entity_key)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = 0, yend = entity_key, color = geo_region, alpha = is_rest)) +
  geom_point(aes(color = geo_region, alpha = is_rest), size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(
      aes(label = scales::comma(metric_value, accuracy = 1)),
      hjust = -0.3, size = 2.5, color = "gray30"
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    labels = scales::comma, 
    position = "top",
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.25))
  ) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("FALSE" = 1, "TRUE" = 0.4)) +
  facet_grid(geo_region ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "Export Value (USD Millions)", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_blank(),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 10)
  )

regional_plot <- p_left + p_right +
  plot_annotation(
    title = "Top 3 Exporters per Region: Volume vs. Value (2024)",
    caption = "Source: World Trade Organization | Note: EU treated as single entity",
    theme = theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 14))
  ) &
  scale_color_brewer(palette = "Dark2")

regional_plot
```
